# Livery

> Livery is a car ownership app for drivers in the UK: a private digital garage. You add a car by its registration and Livery keeps everything about owning it in one place: MOT, tax, insurance and service dates with reminders, a service and repair history file, modifications and their power gains, running costs down to the cost per mile, and documents and photos. It is open to everyone on the web at https://app.liveryclub.com, with iPhone and Android apps coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.

Pricing: Livery Free covers up to two cars with MOT and tax lookups, key date countdowns and reminders, service history, mods, running costs and documents. Livery Plus costs £5.99 a month or £49.99 a year (launch offer: £39.99 a year, kept for as long as you stay subscribed, for anyone who subscribes before the end of 31 January 2027) and adds Ask Livery (an AI car helper that answers from your own records and reads photos, invoices and PDFs), unlimited cars, receipt scanning, fuel economy and MPG tracking with drop alerts, an MOT advisory tracker, a clean air zone and ULEZ check, a business mileage log at HMRC rates, and shared garages for family and partners. Coming to Plus: two full vehicle history checks a month and free car valuations. Smart nudges to log fuel and costs are coming to every plan.

Livery is made by Chakraborty Group LTD in the UK. Data is stored on servers in London, each account can only see its own garage, and accounts can be deleted at any time.
